FFmpeg runtime of the screen viewer (Windows)
=============================================

The Windows screen viewer of Smart Explorer decodes H.264, HEVC and AV1 with
FFmpeg (libavcodec, libavutil, libswresample). Smart Explorer distributes the
unmodified shared libraries of one pinned build and loads them at run time;
it is not linked against them at build time.

Build: BtbN FFmpeg-Builds, release autobuild-2026-10-31-12-59,
  ffmpeg-n8.1.3-27-g8dca1586f4-win64-lgpl-shared-8.1.zip
  https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/autobuild-2026-10-31-12-59/ffmpeg-n8.1.3-27-g8dca1586f4-win64-lgpl-shared-8.1.zip
  SHA-256 of the archive: 5cef7bc48e513f3cee7c881e8b2999d835541edb1846c3e89443a67f8f8556ab
Libraries: avcodec-62.dll (libavcodec 62.28.103), avutil-60.dll
  (libavutil 60.26.103), swresample-6.dll (libswresample 6)
FFmpeg source: https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git, branch release/8.1,
  commit 8dca1586f4 (tag n8.1.3 plus 27 commits); https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
Build scripts: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds (variant "lgpl", shared)

The build is configured with --enable-version3 and without --enable-gpl and
--enable-nonfree: the libraries are licensed under the GNU Lesser General
Public License version 3 (LGPL v3). The LGPL v3 text (LICENSE.txt of the
archive) and the GNU GPL v3 text it refers to accompany this notice. The
libraries include further libraries under permissive licenses (for example
dav1d, BSD-2-Clause), as listed by the build scripts above.

Replacing the libraries (LGPL v3, section 4 d 1): Smart Explorer checks the
bundled libraries against their SHA-256 values. To use a modified,
interface-compatible build instead (FFmpeg 8.1 ABI: avcodec-62, avutil-60,
swresample-6), set the environment variable SE_FFMPEG_DIR to the directory
that holds avutil-60.dll, swresample-6.dll and avcodec-62.dll; the viewer
then loads that directory without the SHA-256 check (it still checks the
major versions and the structure layouts it uses).
